text_block_list.text:
The Hidaka Mountains—often hailed as the 
"backbone of Hokkaido,"— 
stretch for roughly 150 kilometers, 
piercing straight through the Hidaka 
subprefecture to reach Cape Erimo at its 
southern tip.

Aiming for a certain mountain in that 
range, I had embarked on an extended trip. 
Before starting my official duties as a 
novice 
trainer, I wanted to fire myself up in an 
unforgiving environment.
choice_data_list: (My destination—windswept Erimo!)

text_block_list.text:
The morning after my arrival, I headed up 
the mountain and walked along the hiking 
trail. 
The Hidaka Mountains are rugged and steep, 
but all the greener for it. I paused and 
took a deep, steady breath...
choice_data_list: Haaah... Even the air tastes delicious—

text_block_list.text: (Rustle... rustle!)

choice_data_list: Whoa!?

text_block_list.text:
"Ah...! Forgive me for startling you. 
Please pay me no mind... Excuse me—"
choice_data_list: Ah, wait! That way is...!

text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl had suddenly dropped right out 
of the treetops. That alone was shocking 
enough, 
but she was dashing off into the deep, 
untamed wilderness far off the hiking 
trail.
choice_data_list:
(I'm worried she'll get lost... I have to 
go after her!)

(I'm worried she'll get lost... I should 
follow her!)

text_block_list.text:
—However, I lost sight of her in an 
instant. Checking my current location on 
my phone, 
it looked like this was as far as I could 
safely go and still make it back to the 
trail...

(...Chirp, chirr...) 
(Rustle... rustle, crackle... snap...)
choice_data_list: ......I-I'd better turn back right now.

text_block_list.text:
Right at that moment—in the corner of my 
vision, I caught something wobbling 
faintly. For a second, 
I tensed up... but it appeared to be a 
fox. An extremely gaunt and malnourished 
one at that...
choice_data_list: Whoa, it's heading this way...!

text_block_list.text:
—Please stay right where you are! Keep 
your distance!
choice_data_list: Waaahhhh!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Ezo Red Fox
text_block_list.text: YELP...!

"...Okay, that should do it. 
...I am so sorry for startling you yet 
again..."

"However, Ezo red foxes can carry a 
parasite called echinococcus. 
If you were to become infected, it would 
be extremely dangerous..."
choice_data_list: You were protecting me... Thank you.

You stepped in to protect me... Thank you 
so much.

text_block_list.text:
Still... that fox looked filthy and 
terribly weak. 
Could it have approached me in search of 
food?
choice_data_list:
...Do you think that little guy will be 
okay?

text_block_list.text:
"I wonder...  
...It may not survive the summer."
choice_data_list: What...?

text_block_list.text:
"At this time of year, there ought to be 
plenty of food around. 
Even so, in that condition..."
choice_data_list: That's terrible...

text_block_list.text:
"...It breaks your heart, doesn't it? I 
feel the same way. 
Yet, it is not merely a sorrowful thing."

"That creature—will in turn become rich 
soil to nurture new life. 
As part of the mountain... it will 
experience a different kind of summer..."

A sudden lump rose in my throat. What I 
was looking at wasn't just untouched 
nature... 
It was a landscape formed by every single 
life that had ever flourished and layered 
upon this mountain.
choice_data_list: (She... truly understands that.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon my lack of manners for not 
introducing myself sooner. 
I am—Daring Tact."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"By the way... there was something I 
wanted to ask. 
You chased after me... didn't you? May I 
ask why?"
choice_data_list:
I was worried about you... so I ran after 
you.

I was worried for your safety... so I 
followed you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Eh? ......! O-Of course. It must have 
looked like I 
wandered off the path... I am so sorry for 
causing you concern."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Please do not worry. This mountain 
belongs to an acquaintance of mine... I've 
played here 
ever since I was little, so I know it 
intimately. It is practically my own 
backyard, so to speak."
choice_data_list:
I see... Well, as long as you're safe, 
that's what matters. I'll head back.

I see... As long as you're fine, that's 
all that counts. I'll be on my way back.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... Please wait! 
If you'd like, would you care to stop by 
my campsite?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"You must be exhausted after hiking up the 
mountain trail, yes? 
It is quite close from here, so why not 
catch your breath before heading down?"
choice_data_list:
Well, if you insist... I'll take you up on 
that.

text_block_list.text:
Following her lead up the mountain path— 
the view suddenly opened wide before us, 
and a refreshing breeze swept across my 
entire body.
choice_data_list: Whoa... What an incredible view!
Whoa... What a breathtaking view!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it? ...Here, please have some 
water. It comes from a natural spring, 
but it's a managed water source and I have 
boiled it, so please don't worry."
choice_data_list: Thank you...!

text_block_list.text:
Taking a sip of water washed away the 
fatigue from hiking the trail in an 
instant. 
Yet what soothed my soul above all else... 
was the magnificent panorama unfolding 
right before my eyes.
choice_data_list: It's truly... gorgeous.
It's truly... stunning.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Hehe, do you like it? 
I love the view from here so much... that 
I pitched my camp right on this spot."
choice_data_list: I see—oh, that bird over there...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that is a hazel grouse. In Japan, 
they inhabit only Hokkaido. 
How fortunate; they aren't often spotted 
in this area..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"If you are fond of wildlife... this 
mountain is also home to northern pikas. 
They are elusive and difficult to find, 
but if you watch the rocky crags... you 
might just catch a glimpse."
choice_data_list: You really know your stuff.
You know so much about this place.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... I'm sorry for rambling on like 
that, I got carried away... 
Please feel free to ask me anything if 
you're curious."

Even so, observing her like this... Her 
graceful, lady-like demeanor 
and the rugged mountain setting felt 
somewhat out of place together.
choice_data_list: Is camping... a hobby of yours?
Is camping... your hobby?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than a hobby, it is part of my 
training regimen. 
—Next year, you see... I plan to take the 
Tracen Academy entrance exam."
choice_data_list:
Wait, what?! You're applying to our 
academy?!

Wait, really?! You're taking our academy's 
exam?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Our...?  
...U-Um, forgive me, but who are you...?"
choice_data_list:
Actually, I'm an academy trainer! Here, my 
business card.

Actually, I'm a trainer at Tracen! Here, 
my card.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Eh...?!  
...Ah, it's true..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"My goodness, you're really an academy 
trainer...! 
How incredible..."
choice_data_list:
Well, I'm still a greenhorn just starting 
out, but...

Haha, I'm still just a rookie finding my 
feet, though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that's amazing! 
I hear the trainer licensing exams are 
incredibly difficult, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
There must be so many wonderful horsegirls 
and trainers at Tracen Academy 
who made it through those brutal trials...

She looks at me with eyes full of pure 
admiration, yet she's about to face 
that very same trial herself... It makes 
me curious to see how she runs.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see you run sometime.
I'd love to see you run sometime.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! Really!? Wow... Yes, I'd be honored! 
...Um, if it's not too much to ask... 
would you give me some advice, too?
choice_data_list: If you don't mind advice from a rookie...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, I'm thrilled! 
I've never had any formal coaching before, 
so...
choice_data_list:
Wait... aren't you enrolled in a 
development club?

Wait... aren't you enrolled in a 
development club?

text_block_list.text:
A development club is essentially a prep 
school for racing, 
designed to educate and train young 
children aspiring to compete.

Normally, anyone aiming for Tracen Academy 
joins a development club first 
to learn the fundamental techniques before 
taking the entrance exam... or so I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No. 
—I've never belonged to a development 
club.

title: The Horsegirl Encountered in the Northern Wilds
